    Coherent coefficients for the repeated middle of Figure 13 #

    This file constructs the scalar coefficient maps needed on the middle chain 1, tau, tau^2 and extends them coherently to the two arms and outer composite of the Figure-13 shape. The construction is pure linear algebra: a functional descends through a linear map when the latter's kernel is contained in the former's kernel, and a functional on a subspace extends over a field.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.exists_linearMap_comp_eq_of_ker_le {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type v} {W : Type w} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] (F : V →ₗ[k] W) (ell : V →ₗ[k] k) (hker : F.ker ≤ ell.ker) :
    ∃ (L : W →ₗ[k] k), L ∘ₗ F = ell

    A scalar linear functional descends through a linear map precisely when the map's kernel is contained in the functional's kernel. Over a field, the resulting functional on the range extends to the whole codomain.

        Residue coefficients can be divided coherently by a radical parameter through degree two, provided the parameter and its square are nonzero and every residue-zero element is divisible by the parameter.
